spans.s: हुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Offered as an oblation, sacrificed; 2. one to whom an oblation is offered, R.ii.71.
हुत (II) m. An epithet of Śiva.
हुत (III) n. An oblation, an offering.
हुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Offered as an oblation, sacrificed; 2. one to whom an oblation is offered, R.ii.71.
हूत a. (f. ता) Called, invited, summoned, (pp. of ह्वे q.v.).
हूत a. (f. ता) Called, invited, summoned, (pp. of ह्वे q.v.).
हुत-अग्नि a. who has offered oblations to fire, R.i.
हुत-अशन m. 1. fire, दिनांते निहितं तेजः सवित्रेव हुताशनः R.iv.1, K.S.iii.21; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
हुत-अशन˚सहाय m. an epithet of Śiva.
हुत-अशनी f. the full-moon-day in the month of Phālguna.
हुत-आश f. fire, प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य हुतं हुताशम् R.ii.71, Bg.xi.19.
हुत-जातवेदस् a. one who has made an oblation to fire.
हुत-भुज् m. fire, नैशस्यार्चिर्हुतभुज इव च्छिन्नभूयिष्ठधूमा Vikr.i.
हुतभुक्प्रिया f. Svāhā, the wife of Agni.
हुत-वह m. fire, शीतांशुस्तपनो हिमं हुतवहः क्रिडामुदो यातनाः Git.G.ix., हुतवहपरिखेदादाश निर्गत्य कक्षात् Rt.i.27.
हुत-होम m. a Brāhmaṇa who has offered an oblation.
